title: 01. Halfway Home
description: Late-night asphalt rhythm, four-on-the-floor kick, and urgent heartland rock vocals.

title: 02. The Mill Clock
description: Weathered acoustic guitar, pulsing bassline, and working-class poetry marking time on the factory floor.

title: 03. Born for the Passenger Seat
file: music/03 - Born for the Passenger Seat.mp3
description: Steady highway tempo, Telecaster bite, and bittersweet reflections from the shotgun side of the cab.

title: 04. Leave the Light in the Hollow
file: music/04 - Leave the Light in the Hollow.mp3
description: The explosive lead single — rising from quiet kitchen gravel into a roof-shaking chest-voice cry.

title: 05. Cheap Amen
description: Foot-stomping acoustic grit and front-pew confessionals on grace, second chances, and Sunday morning doubts.

title: 06. Whiskey Weather
description: Rain on a tin roof, warm Rhodes piano, and whiskey-soaked melancholia as cold fronts roll through.

title: 07. Don't Wait Up
description: Driving rhythm acoustic, urgent vocal delivery, and the restless pull of headlights on the blacktop.

title: 08. The Letter I Don't Send
file: music/08 - The Letter I Don't Send.mp3
description: Raw, unadorned acoustic picking and aching falsetto breaks on unsent words and long memories.

title: 09. If Lonely's a Country
description: Intimate front-porch fingerpicking and room piano on memory, solitude, and learning to live in a habit.

title: 10. That's the Whole Prayer
description: Reverent acoustic chords and soaring vocal resonance closing the album with humble, raw gratitude.
